title: “I Lost 17 Oscars, But I Won a Pig”: How Diane Warren Saved Wilbur
summary: The perennial Oscar nominee finally won something — a silent auction to adopt a runaway swine that somehow ended up stranded in West Hollywood.

title: ‘Electra/Persona’ Theater Review: Cate Blanchett and Nina Hoss Are Magnificent in Benedict Andrews’ Ambitious Double Bill
summary: The 'Tar' co-stars take turns playing four roles, two each night, as they explore thematic cross-currents between Sophocles and Bergman.
